verdict.rationale: replica-skill is a Claude Code skill pack that runs app-cloning stages in sequence, writing artifacts to a `replica/` folder. Versioning, reviewing and rolling back workflows is a fair question for this kind of tool, but the evidence documents no such feature. Keeping the `replica/` folder or skills in a repo would be a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
